excerpts.author: jsign
excerpts.content: Calculating the commitment requires you to have the ("encrypted") powers of tau. If the trusted setup goes up to degree `m`, then you can't do the commitment calculation for polynomials with bigger powers. "can't" means literally not having the information to do the polynomial evaluation.

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <dankrad> Yes, correct. The powers of tau limit the polynomials you can commit to
